name: io.github.GhostFaceModz/android-use
title: android-use
description: Let AI agents see and control an Android phone over ADB, with safety guards.

environmentVariables.name: ADB_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of device serials (from `adb devices`). Recommended.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_SHELL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the raw `shell` tool (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_SENSITIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable the banking/payments/messaging app guard (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: SENSITIVE_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: Extra comma-separated package names to treat as sensitive.

environmentVariables.name: ADB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the adb binary if it is not on PATH.
